quota_name: All APIs - API keys per API
description: Maximum number of API keys per API

quota_name: All APIs - Authentication providers per API
description: The maximum number of authentication providers per API

quota_name: All APIs - Functions per pipeline resolver or handler
description: Maximum number of functions per pipeline resolver or handler

quota_name: All APIs - Handler, resolver, and function code size
description: Maximum code size of handlers, resolvers, and functions running on APPSYNC_JS runtime.

quota_name: All APIs - Iterations per loops in resolvers, functions, and handlers
description: Maximum number of iterations in #foreach...#end loops

quota_name: All APIs - Number of custom domain names
description: The maximum number of custom domain names per region

quota_name: All APIs - Request execution time
description: Maximum request execution time

quota_name: All APIs - Resolvers, functions, and handlers response size
description: Maximum size of the evaluated resolver, function, or handler template

quota_name: All APIs - Subscription payload size
description: Maximum size of the message received via subscriptions

quota_name: All APIs - Subscriptions per client connection
description: Subscriptions code statements per client in a single WebSocket connection. Each statement allows the client to receive multiple messages related to the specific subscription.

quota_name: Event APIs - APIs per region
description: The maximum number of AppSync Event APIs per region

quota_name: Event APIs - Batch size per publish request
description: The maximum number of events that can be batched in one publish operation.

quota_name: Event APIs - Channel namespaces per API
description: The maximum number of channel namespaces on an Event API

quota_name: Event APIs - Number of characters allowed in a channel segment
description: The maximum character length of a channel segment

quota_name: Event APIs - Number of segments allowed in a channel
description: The maximum number of segments in a channel

quota_name: Event APIs - Publish payload size
description: The maximum size of the entire payload sent in a publish operation

quota_name: Event APIs - Rate of connections per API
description: The maximum number of Event API connect requests per second.

quota_name: Event APIs - Rate of inbound events per API
description: The maximum number of inbound events per second. Each published event generates a single inbound event.

quota_name: Event APIs - Rate of outbound messages per API
description: The maximum number of outbound metered events per second. One metered event equals 5 kB of delivered event.

quota_name: Event APIs - Rate of publish requests per client connection
description: The maximum number of publish requests per second per WebSocket connection. WebSocket publish requests are also evaluated against the rate of request tokens quota.

quota_name: Event APIs - Rate of request tokens
description: The maximum number of request tokens per second for Event APIs in this account in the current Region. AWS AppSync allocates tokens to publish requests based on the amount of resources (processing time and memory) that they consume and the number of 5kB messages published.

quota_name: GraphQL APIs - APIs per region
description: Maximum number of GraphQL APIs per region

quota_name: GraphQL APIs - Max Batch Size per request
description: The maximum length of the resolver request list that will be sent to a single Lambda function for a BatchInvoke operation.

quota_name: GraphQL APIs - Maximum query length
description: Maximum length of a GraphQL query, measured in tokens (15,000). Tokens are individual parsed elements of the query string. Queries exceeding this limit will fail with the error message 'Maximum char length exceeded'.

quota_name: GraphQL APIs - Number of caching keys
description: The maximum number of caching keys

quota_name: GraphQL APIs - Rate of connections per API
description: The maximum number of GraphQL API connect requests per second.

quota_name: GraphQL APIs - Rate of inbound messages per API
description: The maximum number of inbound messages per second. Each subscription type invoked by a mutation generates one inbound message.

quota_name: GraphQL APIs - Rate of outbound messages per API
description: The maximum number of outbound messages per second. One outbound message is equal to 5 KB of payload data delivered.

quota_name: GraphQL APIs - Rate of request tokens
description: The maximum number of request tokens per second for GraphQL APIs in this account in the current Region. AWS AppSync allocates tokens to mutation and query requests based on the amount of resources (processing time and memory) that they consume. For more details on tokens, see the Monitoring section in the AWS AppSync documentation.

quota_name: Graphql APIs - Rate of subscription invalidation requests
description: The maximum number of invalidation requests per second per account per region

quota_name: GraphQL APIs - Request mapping template size
description: Maximum size of the request mapping template

quota_name: GraphQL APIs - Resolvers executed in a single request
description: The maximum number of resolvers that can be executed in a single request

quota_name: GraphQL APIs - Response mapping template size
description: Maximum size of the response mapping template

quota_name: GraphQL APIs - Schema document size
description: Maximum size of the schema document

quota_name: GraphQL APIs - Source API associations per Merged API
description: The maximum number of Source API associations per Merged API.
